entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Consider a more brand-focused name than `dnup` #51448
  • Extract common packagereferences for MSBuild tasks that ship in the SDK #51444

Closed

  • Running events after publishing to single file executable #13760
  • Feature request: Allow opt-out of default Globbing excludes #13735
  • .net6.0 app publish in anyCPU does not run on windows 32bits #26647
  • [10.0-rc.1] dotnet run no longer accepts Windows path separators on Linux #50828
    10.0.1xx
  • dotnet pack fails because is seems to be trying to pack the assembly before it has been build #13557
    Discussion
  • When used with Yocto, dotnet publish sometimes fails without apparent reason #12376
  • [WebToolsE2E] The version displayed in the SDK installer for .NET 10 GA includes build number info #51234
  • [NETSDKE2E][MAC][Regression] Unable to build project created with .NET 10 GA. #51409

PullRequests

Created

  • Add automation for merging dnup to release/dnup #51447
  • Respond to `dnup` feedback from prototype code review #51446
  • Extract common PackageReferences for MSBuild tasks that ship in the SDK #51445
  • Improve clarity of 'dotnet project convert' output directory prompt #51443
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51442
  • Add NETSDK1234 warning for macOS apps with .App or .Service suffix #51441

Merged

  • Fix dotnet run to accept Windows path separators on Linux #50889
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Fix dotnet run to accept Windows path separators on Linux #51436

Updated

  • Update versions .props based on the RC2 build #51414
  • dnup code review #50988
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add support for await using and await foreach in DetectPreviewFeatureAnalyzer #51415
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51402
    Area-Templates, Area-AspNetCore, Area-CodeFlow
  • [dotnet-cli] prompt for target framework using `Spectre.Console` #51430
    Area-Infrastructure
  • OTel experimentation #49409
    Area-CLI
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #51026
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51376
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add source package for file-based programs support #51373
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2823449 #51419
    Branch Lockdown
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51207
  • [main] Fix dll detection in dotnet test #51264
